dict.string: luma bar uses automation only for Agent actions you request, such as reading the active browser tab or sending a confirmed message.
luma bar scans and plays your local music library for the notch music controls.
luma bar looks up a contact only when you ask the Agent to prepare a message to that person.
luma bar runs Agent shell commands that you explicitly confirm, including commands that may access Desktop files.
luma bar runs Agent shell commands that you explicitly confirm, including commands that may access Documents files.
luma bar runs Agent shell commands that you explicitly confirm, including commands that may access Downloads files.
luma bar records your voice only when you start Voice Whisper, then turns it into notes, commit messages, or shell commands.
luma bar runs Agent shell commands that you explicitly confirm, including commands that may access network volumes.
luma bar runs Agent shell commands that you explicitly confirm, including commands that may access removable volumes.
luma bar captures the active game window only when you request screenshot analysis.
luma bar uses speech recognition only when you start Voice Whisper.
